summary: Futurewave Acquisition Corp, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing that its units may be separated into ordinary shares, rights, and warrants starting July 31, 2026. This is a routine administrative event enabling separate trading of the component securities, not a special situation. The announcement includes no deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic action. The filing merely facilitates unit separation via the transfer agent, with no financial or structural implications beyond standard SPAC unit mechanics.
